reviews.title: Another good Starbrite product
reviews.body: I just used it on my interior companionway. It goes on eawsy anyy absorbs quickly and dries quickly. I plan on putting on several coats over a period of days when I'm down at the boat. It pays to buy this at Amazon it was about $20, but at WEst Marine it was about $36. It looks like I could have bought 32oz. for $1.00 more but the 16OZ size will last me a decade or more.Starebrite products all seem to be good and fit for their purpose.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 8, 2017
reviews.author: Paul B. Berg

reviews.title: Essential Teak Oil for Furniture Restoration
reviews.body: Used to start refinishing my teak bench.First time I’ve ever attempted refinishing my old teak bench which has sat outside for 15 years.I did remove the accumulated debris first with Oxalic acid I purchased on Amazon.If you are looking to restore an older teak piece, don’t skip this step for best results!I’m not done yet, I had time for a first pass, will resume again in the spring or summer.A can’t miss product as long as you spend the time to properly prep your teak furniture before applying the Teak oil.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on January 17, 2026
reviews.author: wishful thinker

reviews.title: Washed off after a week
reviews.body: It washed off my teak deck a few days after putting it on. I used starbright teak cleaner & and lightener first, then put on a coat of the oil. Several days later I went to wash the deck off with just a regular garden hose and noticed the runoff was the same color as the teak oil. Sure enough, that’s what it was. You would never know it had ever been oiled a week later. Maybe you have to put a new coat on every week but I still don’t get why it washes off with a garden hose though. Seems it would soak into the teak and stay for a few months at least. Mine lasted a week.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on October 17, 2025
reviews.author: EspressoMan

features: SUPERIOR PROTECTION - STAR BRITE Teak Oil beautifies and protects teak and other hardwoods, making it perfect for marine applications, outdoor furniture, and more
UV INHIBITORS - Our formula contains UV absorbers to resist weathering and protect against sun, salt, alkalies, acids, and future stains
DEEP PENETRATION - Unlike varnishes, our teak oil penetrates deep into the wood for maximum protection, preserving the natural wood grain and color
EASY APPLICATION & FAST-DRYING - Apply to a dry surface, let it soak, then wipe off excess; our high-quality ingredients ensure a fast-drying formula
LONG-LASTING PROTECTION - Our long-lasting formula ensures your wood stays protected for longer; reapply at the first sign of weathering
VERSATILE USE - Perfect for boats, decks, pools, trim, patio furniture, and other fine woods - Also excellent for shower stools and bath mats
PROUDLY MADE IN THE USA - Since 1973, Star brite products have been crafted with pride in the United States, ensuring quality and reliability
